description: This file defines the KpiDao class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for database operations related to KPI entities such as saving, fetching, deletion, and validation within the Performance module.

classes.name: KpiDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for KPI entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and KPI-specific validations within the performance management context.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Persists a Kpi entity to the database.

methods.name: getKpiById
methods.description: Retrieves a KPI by its ID if it exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: getExistingKpiIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing KPI IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: getKpiList
methods.description: Fetches a list of KPIs based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpiCount
methods.description: Returns the count of KPIs matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpiQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a query builder wrapped with filtering, sorting, and pagination for KPIs.

methods.name: getDefaultKpi
methods.description: Fetches the KPI marked as default, if any.

methods.name: deleteKpi
methods.description: Marks KPIs as deleted, considering constraints such as associated performance reviews.

methods.name: unsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Removes the default KPI status from the specified ID, or all if ID is null.

methods.name: isKpiEditable
methods.description: Checks if the KPI is editable based on whether it is linked to active performance reviews.

methods.name: isKpiDeletable
methods.description: Checks if the KPI can be deleted based on its associations with inactive performance reviews.
